description: [Ncloud Storage] List objects in a Ncloud Storage bucket (GET /?list-type=2). Supports prefix, delimiter, maxKeys, startAfter and continuation-token pagination; each entry includes its storage class.

bucketName.description: Name of the Ncloud Storage bucket

continuationToken.description: Pagination: nextContinuationToken of the previous response

maxKeys.description: Maximum number of keys to return (1–1,000, default 1,000)

prefix.description: Limits results to keys beginning with this prefix

name: ncloud_ncs_list_objects
